description: Who pays this x402 address, in bands? One signed fact for a seller's pay-to on Base: the share of its payers, and of its revenue, in the last 7 days that looks like sweeps or graders, and the share that came back, each as a band (under 10%, 10 to 25%, 25 to 50%, 50 to 75%, over 75%). Sweeps are checked on a random sample of one-visit payers when there are many, with the range in band edges. The full payer list is the payers tool. Asked again the same UTC day with its ETag, it's a free 304. Price: $0.005 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.005 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.
